entities.name: Johann Baptist Franzelin

entities.summary: Johannes Baptist Franzelin was an Austrian Jesuit theologian and Cardinal. A papal theologian at the First Vatican Council, he assisted with drafting the Apostolic Constitutions composed during the council.
